verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw wə·’el kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Speak to Aaron . . . his sons . . . and all the Israelites . . . and tell them this . . . is what the LORD . . . has commanded
verses.literalPt: Fala a Arão e aos seus filhos, e a todos os filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR ordenou, dizendo:

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֜ט שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ־ כֶ֛שֶׂב אוֹ־ עֵ֖ז בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה א֚וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁחַ֔ט מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yiš·ḥaṭ šō·wr ’ōw- ḵe·śeḇ ’ōw- ‘êz bam·ma·ḥă·neh ’ōw ’ă·šer yiš·ḥaṭ mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: Anyone . . . from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox a lamb or a goat in the camp . . . - or outside of it
verses.literalPt: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel que degolar boi, ou cordeiro, ou cabra, no arraial, ou quem os degolar fora do arraial,

verses.original: וְאֶל־ פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לֹ֣א הֱבִיאוֹ֒ לְהַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּן֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה דָּ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֞ב לָאִ֤ישׁ הַהוּא֙ דָּ֣ם שָׁפָ֔ךְ וְנִכְרַ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lō hĕ·ḇî·’ōw lə·haq·rîḇ qār·bān Yah·weh lip̄·nê miš·kan Yah·weh dām yê·ḥā·šêḇ lā·’îš ha·hū dām šā·p̄āḵ wə·niḵ·raṯ hā·’îš ha·hū miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle that man shall incur bloodguilt He has shed blood and must be cut off . . . . . . from among his people
verses.literalPt: E não os trouxer à porta da tenda da congregação, para oferecer oferta ao SENHOR diante do tabernáculo do SENHOR, a esse homem será imputado o sangue; derramou sangue; por isso será extirpado do seu povo;

verses.original: לְמַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶֽת־ זִבְחֵיהֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֣ם זֹבְחִים֮ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶה֒ וֶֽהֱבִיאֻ֣ם לַֽיהוָ֗ה אֶל־ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְזָ֨בְח֜וּ זִבְחֵ֧י שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַֽיהוָ֖ה אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer yā·ḇî·’ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ziḇ·ḥê·hem ’ă·šer hêm zō·ḇə·ḥîm ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh we·hĕ·ḇî·’um Yah·weh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’el- hak·kō·hên wə·zā·ḇə·ḥū ziḇ·ḥê šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: For this reason the Israelites . . . will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they have been offering in the open fields They are to bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and offer them as sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Para que os filhos de Israel, trazendo os seus sacrifícios, que oferecem sobre a face do campo, os tragam ao SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação, ao sacerdote, e os ofereçam por sacrifícios pacíficos ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְזָרַ֨ק הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ הַדָּם֙ עַל־ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהִקְטִ֣יר הַחֵ֔לֶב לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·raq hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- had·dām ‘al- miz·baḥ Yah·weh pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·hiq·ṭîr ha·ḥê·leḇ lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest will then splatter the blood on the altar of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat as a pleasing aroma to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote espargirá o sangue sobre o altar do SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação, e queimará a gordura por cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יִזְבְּח֥וּ עוֹד֙ אֶת־ זִבְחֵיהֶ֔ם לַשְּׂעִירִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶה־ זֹּ֥את לָהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiz·bə·ḥū ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- ziḇ·ḥê·hem laś·śə·‘î·rim ’ă·šer hêm zō·nîm ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām tih·yeh- zōṯ lā·hem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām
verses.literal: They must no longer offer their sacrifices to the goat demons to which they have prostituted themselves This will be a permanent statute for them for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: E nunca mais oferecerão os seus sacrifícios aos demônios, após os quais eles se prostituem; isto ser-lhes-á por estatuto perpétuo nas suas gerações.

verses.original: וַאֲלֵהֶ֣ם תֹּאמַ֔ר אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־ יָג֣וּר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה אוֹ־ זָֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·lê·hem tō·mar ’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·min- hag·gêr ’ă·šer- yā·ḡūr bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·leh ‘ō·lāh ’ōw- zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: Tell them that if anyone . . . from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice
verses.literalPt: Dize-lhes pois: Qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre vós, que oferecer holocausto ou sacrifício,

verses.original: וְאֶל־ פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לֹ֣א יְבִיאֶ֔נּוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹת֖וֹ לַיהוָ֑ה וְנִכְרַ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַה֖וּא מֵעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lō yə·ḇî·’en·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·ṯōw Yah·weh wə·niḵ·raṯ hā·’îš ha·hū mê·‘am·māw
verses.literal: but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD that man must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: E não o trouxer à porta da tenda da congregação, para oferecê-lo ao SENHOR, esse homem será extirpado do seu povo.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאכַ֖ל כָּל־ דָּ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֣י פָנַ֗י בַּנֶּ֙פֶשׁ֙ הָאֹכֶ֣לֶת אֶת־ הַדָּ֔ם וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·min- hag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’ă·šer yō·ḵal kāl- dām wə·nā·ṯat·tî p̄ā·nay ban·ne·p̄eš hā·’ō·ḵe·leṯ ’eṯ- had·dām wə·hiḵ·rat·tî ’ō·ṯāh miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·māh
verses.literal: If anyone . . . from the house of Israel or a foreigner living among them eats any blood I will set My face against that person - and cut him off from among his people
verses.literalPt: E qualquer homem da casa de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre eles, que comer algum sangue, contra aquela alma porei a minha face, e a extirparei do seu povo.

verses.original: כִּ֣י נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַבָּשָׂר֮ בַּדָּ֣ם הִוא֒ וַאֲנִ֞י נְתַתִּ֤יו לָכֶם֙ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ הַדָּ֥ם ה֖וּא בַּנֶּ֥פֶשׁ יְכַפֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ne·p̄eš hab·bā·śār bad·dām hî wa·’ă·nî nə·ṯat·tîw lā·ḵem ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ lə·ḵap·pêr ‘al- nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem kî- had·dām hū ban·ne·p̄eš yə·ḵap·pêr
verses.literal: For the life of the flesh is in the blood and I have given it to you to make atonement for your souls upon the altar for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul
verses.literalPt: Porque a vida da carne está no sangue; pelo que vo-lo tenho dado sobre o altar, para fazer expiação pelas vossas almas; porquanto é o sangue que fará expiação pela alma.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֤ן אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּל־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ מִכֶּ֖ם לֹא־ תֹ֣אכַל דָּ֑ם וְהַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶ֖ם לֹא־ יֹ֥אכַל דָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ā·mar·tî liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl kāl- ne·p̄eš mik·kem lō- ṯō·ḵal dām wə·hag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem lō- yō·ḵal dām
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I say to the Israelites . . . None . . . . . . of you may eat blood nor may any foreigner living among you eat blood
verses.literalPt: Portanto tenho dito aos filhos de Israel: Nenhum dentre vós comerá sangue, nem o estrangeiro, que peregrine entre vós, comerá sangue.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמִן־ הַגֵּר֙ הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצ֜וּד צֵ֥יד חַיָּ֛ה אוֹ־ ע֖וֹף אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֑ל וְשָׁפַךְ֙ אֶת־ דָּמ֔וֹ וְכִסָּ֖הוּ בֶּעָפָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’îš mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·min- hag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’ă·šer yā·ṣūḏ ṣêḏ ḥay·yāh ’ōw- ‘ō·wp̄ ’ă·šer yê·’ā·ḵêl wə·šā·p̄aḵ ’eṯ- dā·mōw wə·ḵis·sā·hū be·‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: And if any . . . Israelite . . . . . . or foreigner living among them hunts down a wild animal or bird that may be eaten he must drain its blood and cover it with dirt
verses.literalPt: Também qualquer homem dos filhos de Israel, ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam entre eles, que caçar animal ou ave que se come, derramará o seu sangue, e o cobrirá com pó;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר דָּמ֣וֹ בְנַפְשׁוֹ֮ הוּא֒ וָֽאֹמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּ֥ם כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ כִּ֣י נֶ֤פֶשׁ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ דָּמ֣וֹ הִ֔וא כָּל־ אֹכְלָ֖יו יִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ne·p̄eš kāl- bā·śār dā·mōw ḇə·nap̄·šōw hū wā·’ō·mar liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl dam kāl- bā·śār lō ṯō·ḵê·lū kî ne·p̄eš kāl- bā·śār dā·mōw hî kāl- ’ō·ḵə·lāw yik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: For the life of all flesh is its blood Therefore I have told the Israelites . . . You must not eat the blood of any living thing because the life of all flesh is its blood whoever . . . eats it must be cut off
verses.literalPt: Porquanto a vida de toda a carne é o seu sangue; por isso tenho dito aos filhos de Israel: Não comereis o sangue de nenhuma carne, porque a vida de toda a carne é o seu sangue; qualquer que o comer será extirpado.

verses.original: וְכָל־ נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֤ל נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה בָּאֶזְרָ֖ח וּבַגֵּ֑ר וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם וְטָמֵ֥א עַד־ הָעֶ֖רֶב וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer tō·ḵal nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh bā·’ez·rāḥ ū·ḇag·gêr wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘e·reḇ wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: And any person whether native or foreigner who eats anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts must wash his clothes and bathe with water and he will be unclean until evening then he will be clean
verses.literalPt: E todo o homem entre os naturais, ou entre os estrangeiros, que comer corpo morto ou dilacerado, lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará com água, e será imundo até à tarde; depois será limpo.

verses.original: וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַבֵּ֔ס וּבְשָׂר֖וֹ לֹ֣א יִרְחָ֑ץ וְנָשָׂ֖א עֲוֺנֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im lō yə·ḵab·bês ū·ḇə·śā·rōw lō yir·ḥāṣ wə·nā·śā ‘ă·wō·nōw
verses.literal: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself . . . then he shall bear his iniquity
verses.literalPt: Mas, se os não lavar, nem banhar a sua carne, levará sobre si a sua iniqüidade.
